title: Claim ledger row
description: One row of the claimLedger array of the documentation inventory (plan §6.2). Enumerated values are not repeated here: a property marked x-vocabulary is checked against that section of claim-and-disposition-vocabulary.json, which is the only place the allowed values live. x-plan62 marks the fifteen fields plan §6.2 requires; x-filledBy names the step that must fill a field the inventory leaves empty today. rationale is optional on a row because the inventory item carries a rationale for every file.

claimId.description: Opaque claim identity, independent of path and position. Rows whose identity could not be carried forward use the identity_gap form.

sourcePath.description: Repository-relative POSIX path of the source file.

sourceAnchor.description: Stable heading slug or unheaded-block ordinal inside the source.

sourceDigest.description: SHA-256 of the whole source file.

sourceUnitDigest.description: SHA-256 of this claim's source unit text (conservation proof).

sourceLocation.description: One-based inclusive line span of the source unit.

targetOwner.description: Path of the one document that will own the claim; null until a target is assigned.
targetOwner.x-filledBy: Target owner assignment during the pilot and transformation steps; the inventory has it only for rows proposed promote or merge.

targetAnchor.description: Anchor of the claim inside targetOwner; null until the claim is placed in a target.
targetAnchor.x-filledBy: Transformation of each area; only promoted portals carry it today.

claimKind.x-filledBy: Classification of every unclassified row during the pilot and transformation steps.

status.description: Current, future or historical status of the claim.

relations.description: Typed relations to other claims or sources.
relations.x-filledBy: Typed relations beyond duplicate content are added during cross-area review.

decisionRefs.description: Decision identifiers cited by the claim.

reviewStatus.x-filledBy: Reviewed status is set by the independent review steps; the inventory emits blocking or pending.

rationale.description: Why the disposition was chosen. Required by dispositions whose requiresRationale is true; the validator also accepts the rationale of the row's inventory item.

identityUnitDigest.description: Digest used to carry identity across commits.

identityFingerprint.description: Content fingerprint used to carry identity across commits.

semanticClaimId.description: Shared by rows with identical content in several source files.

sourceOccurrences.description: Every source path that holds the identical content; one is marked canonical.
